0022600149.text: The Pelicans, 1-4 and 14th in the West, host the 3-3 Hawks, who are 7th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, in New Orleans' sixth game of the season. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), while Dejounte Murray (personal) and Jordan Poole (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Pelicans lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 117-100 in Atlanta on January 7, 2026.
